## About
Ghulam Murtuza, known as GMurtuza SEO, is a Karachi-based e-commerce growth strategist and Search Everywhere Optimization specialist. He helps Pakistani D2C and e-commerce brands get found on Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and every platform where customers search. His consultancy, GMurtuza SEO (est. 2021), combines SEO, AEO, GEO, and CRO into one integrated growth strategy. He is currently Senior E-Commerce Executive at J. Junaid Jamshed Private Limited.

## Core Expertise
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — getting brands cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) — featured snippets, AI answer boxes, voice search
- Search Engine Optimization (SEO) — technical SEO, on-page, e-commerce SEO Pakistan
- Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) — UX audits, checkout optimization, A/B testing
- E-Commerce Operations — RTO reduction, last-mile delivery, courier reconciliation Pakistan
